RaceName: Hamilton Park "Hands And Heels" Apprentice Handicap (Part Of The Racing Excellence Series)
Spotlight: 0-12 but she finished second of six at Ayr (6f, good to firm) last month; got going too late when sixth there over 5f on Saturday and may prefer an extra furlong.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Nursery Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Beaten-favourite on his debut before easily winning a weak-looking Musselburgh novice in early June; faced a couple of tough tasks in Listed company since and, while this is much easier, he now has to prove he isn't just going the wrong way; goes up in trip.

RaceName: Download The Oddschecker App Nursery Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 600,000gns half-brother to a useful middle-distance performer in Nightime Dancer (Group 3-placed); built on a promising Polytrack debut when beaten on the nod last time and should have more to offer now upped in trip.

RaceName: Kinrara Gin EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Restricted/Hamilton 2yo Qual') (GBB)
OwnerName: G H Thompson And Michael Dods
Spotlight: Shaped well when third on his debut at Leicester (5f, good to firm) in May and stepped forward from that effort when going close at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) last month; strong claims.

RaceName: Kinrara Gin EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Restricted/Hamilton 2yo Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Placed in two of his first three starts in novice/maiden company and was gelded prior to finishing second of six in a handicap at Ripon (6f, good to firm); solid claims on his return to a novice.

RaceName: Kinrara Gin EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Restricted/Hamilton 2yo Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Has worn blinkers for both starts; took a big step forward from his debut outing when fourth of eight at Pontefract (6f, good to firm; beaten around 2l) six days ago; should be capable of better but that will be needed.

RaceName: Kinrara Gin EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Restricted/Hamilton 2yo Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Best effort from four runs came when second of ten at Leicester (5f, good to firm) in May on his second start; gelded prior to finishing behind Baldetti when fourth of seven at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) last month and better will be needed to reverse placings with that rival.

RaceName: Kinrara Gin EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Restricted/Hamilton 2yo Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Showed little on his debut at Kempton (7f, AW; 25-1) for Grace Harris in June; now drops to 6f and has a visor applied for his stable debut; best watched unless the market speaks in his favour.

RaceName: Kinrara Gin EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C And D) (EBF Restricted/Hamilton 2yo Qual') (GBB)
OwnerName: Peter Onslow & Mr & Mrs Gary Middlebrook
Spotlight: Remote fifth of nine on her debut at Haydock (6f, good to soft) in May but did take a small step forward when sixth of 12 at Chester (6f, good) last month; probably one for handicaps.

RaceName: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker+ Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Winners behind when making a successful debut (5.2f) in April; very short price under a penalty at Thirsk 18 days ago, having been gelded in early June, when second; hard to know what to make of that effort as yet but the front pair were well clear.

RaceName: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker+ Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 100,000gns yearling who holds a few sales race entries; started the bigger price of his trainer's pair when shaping nicely on his Newbury debut last month (clear runner-up won since) and is entitled to improve.

RaceName: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker+ Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: $70,000 foal, $275,000 yearling who's the first offspring of a dirt winner (6f-7f) in the US; likely looking type, who's sporting a tongue-tie on debut, for a yard going great guns this summer with 2yos.

RaceName: David & William McHarg Memorial Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Stayed on into a modest fourth here over 1m1f on his debut and ran to a similar level when third of six over C&D last month; he looks likely to do better in handicaps over longer trips.

RaceName: David & William McHarg Memorial Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Gleneagles colt; eighth foal; half-brother to six winners including Eternal Sunshine (5f-6f; RPR 93), Sound Of Iona (prolific 5f-6f; 91), Oriental Lilly (prolific 5f-7f including AW; 89), Bonito Cavalo (5f-7f AW; 85) and Rory (5f-7f including AW; 75); dam 5f winner (including 2yo; 79); from a family his trainer knows well but he may need this debut experience.

RaceName: David & William McHarg Memorial Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Never threatened when fourth of seven on his debut at Leicester (1m, good) in June and wasn't able to build on that when upped to 1m2f at Pontefract last month; likely one for handicaps.

RaceName: David & William McHarg Memorial Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Brother to US 1m2f AW winner Jitterbug; attracted some support before finishing midfield on his debut at Southwell (7f, AW; 13-2) last month; now steps up to 1m and switches to turf; open to improvement.

RaceName: David & William McHarg Memorial Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 6l second of six behind an easy winner on his debut over this C&D last month; didn't really build on that when third of five at Nottingham (8.5f, good to firm) 12 days ago but still a contender.

RaceName: David & William McHarg Memorial Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Has finished third and run to a similar level in each of his three starts, most recently at Southwell (1m, AW) in June; has been gelded since and has the hood left off on this switch back to turf; he's well bred and could still have more to offer.

RaceName: David & William McHarg Memorial Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Posted an RPR of 80 when fourth of five (beaten 4l) on his debut at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) in June but was beaten 15l when last of six at Sandown (1m2f, good) next time; has since left Richard Hannon and makes his stable debut having been purchased for 12,000gns.

RaceName: David & William McHarg Memorial Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Sent off a big price and showed little on her debut here over 1m3f ten days ago; drops in trip with the hood removed; best watched.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in three runs in Dubai last winter and on his first three starts for this yard; came in for support ahead of his first crack at this trip last Tuesday, though, when easily winning a Catterick handicap from the front; well in under a penalty for that.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Half-sister to useful stayer Alfred Boucher, a winner for the yard in May; shaped as though ready for this sort of trip when a well-held second on her handicap debut (1m4f) four weeks ago; lightly raced and remains open to further improvement.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Reluctant at the start on a few occasions over hurdles in recent times, refusing to jump away on one occasion; has been fine at the stalls in two runs back on the Flat, though, and like Free World is well treated under a penalty following an easy win last Tuesday.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Not as good this year and has looked to have no excuses in some ordinary handicaps of late; only 1lb lower than when well held over 1m6f here 12 days ago and Free World looks his trainer's best chance.

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Expensive to follow since handicapping and is back on the Flat after one try over hurdles late last month (well held); having his first crack at beyond 1m2f and has stamina to prove (dam was best at around 1m).

RaceName: Get Best Odds With Oddschecker Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Regressive maiden (1m2f-2m1f) who's been beaten a long way in three runs this year for her current yard.

RaceName: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap
Spotlight: Won a maiden at Nottingham (8.5f, good) last October and doubled his tally when landing a handicap on soft ground over that same C&D in first-time blinkers two months ago; now 8lb higher but this lightly raced 4yo should still have more to offer; stable won this in 2022.

RaceName: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap
Spotlight: Showed improved form when beating 15 rivals to land a 0-85 York handicap in June (1m1f, good) but he disappointed when favourite at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm) last month; may be capable of bouncing back.

RaceName: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap
Spotlight: Had been shaping well since joining this stable, including when third of five here over 8.5f in June, prior to getting off the mark  at Ayr (1m2f, good) two starts ago; can have a line put through his latest effort in the John Smith's Cup having encountered trouble against the rail; makes the shortlist.

RaceName: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap
Spotlight: Winner of his first three starts in 2025, including here over 8.5f (good), and also went close on heavy ground at Goodwood (1m; first-time cheekpieces) last July; below his best on his first two starts this year but bounced back when runner-up at Chester (1m2f, good to soft) in June; contender.

RaceName: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win came at Cork (1m2f, soft) in April 2024 when trained by Dermot Weld but has posted some good efforts for this stable, including when fourth of 11 at Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month; now steps back up in trip with each-way claims.

RaceName: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap
Spotlight: Returned to form to make all at York (1m, good) in June and backed that up with another good effort at Ripon (1m, good) 24 days ago, finishing a close-up third of seven; runs off the same mark today and could go well over this slightly longer trip.

RaceName: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap
Spotlight: Bounced back from a lesser effort when narrowly beaten in a first-time tongue-tie at Redcar (1m, good) in June before winning at York (1m2f, good) next time; won't mind this drop back in trip and holds claims off this 4lb higher mark.

RaceName: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap
Spotlight: Dual winner in 2024 (1m/1m2f; soft/heavy), the most recent coming in a handicap at Leicester off the same mark as today's; stepped forward from his reappearance when fourth of 14 at Sandown (1m2f, good) two months ago but has been off since; any rain would be welcomed.

RaceName: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap
OwnerName: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde
Spotlight: Six wins last season included one over C&D; went close at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) in June and Ayr (1m, good) last month, before landing a 0-80 at York (1m, good to firm) 17 days ago; steps back up in grade but can't be discounted.

RaceName: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins from 27 starts include one here over 8.5f last May; has finished second in each of his three starts this season (good to soft/soft) but has a bit to do to reverse placings with Return To Unit from their meeting at Nottingham (8.5f, soft) two months ago.

RaceName: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap
OwnerName: Hambleton Racing Ltd XXXV & E Burke
Spotlight: Made a winning reappearance at Musselburgh (1m, good to soft; first start since being gelded) in April and he also went close there over 1m1f in June; down the field at Goodwood (1m2f, good to firm) 12 days ago having raced freely, but it's likely this slight drop back in trip will suit.

RaceName: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap
Spotlight: Won a Thirsk novice over 1m last August; respectable tenth in the Sandringham in June before finishing sixth of ten at Ayr (1m, good) last month; still has stamina to prove for this trip.

RaceName: Kinrara Distillery Scottish Trophy Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time winner for Karl Burke (5f/7f); ran well at Haydock (1m, good) on his stable debut in May but he was below that level on his next two starts, and was safely held when third of four at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) last month.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap
Spotlight: Winner over C&D early last month off a 3lb lower mark (second and fourth successful since); maybe wasn't best suited by the drop to 1m1f behind Katalyst here last time, when hanging right (not for the first time) having looked set to win; holds fair claims.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap
Spotlight: Spent last year sprinting and is having a first try over this far (won over 8.3f here in the spring off 3lb lower); didn't get going until too late in a small field last time (1m) but stamina would be the concern.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap
Spotlight: Half-sister to stayer Alfred Boucher and Joanna Hiffernan (due to run over 2m in the previous race); shown enough in three runs to suggest she's worth keeping an eye on now upped from 1m, but it wouldn't surprise were a stiffer test to suit in due course.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap
Spotlight: Got it together since the eyeshield went on and wasn't best suited by the drop to 1m last time, when ducking right leaving the stalls; hasn't always looked the easiest but this mark feels within range for a stable in good form lately.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap
Spotlight: Mixed bag on turf since handicapping, over various distances, and the visor experiment has quickly been shelved; well worth a look in the market down another 2lb but others have more pressing claims.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap
Spotlight: Goes beyond an extended 1m for the first time (dam did her winning at around this distance) having met plenty of traffic off this mark a month ago; much will depend on the new trip switched from blinkers to cheekpieces.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap
Spotlight: Beat two subsequent winners off 4lb lower on the AW early last month and built on that on her second turf start last time, when coming home nicely for second in a race that didn't pan out her way; high on the shortlist.

RaceName: Oddschecker Free Bets Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden who hasn't always looked straightforward; similar claims to Beauty Generation on 1m1f running here recently but since had no excuses from the front on her first crack at this trip at Windsor; Midnight Media looks her stable's number one.

RaceName: Follow Us On X @hamiltonparkrc Handicap
Spotlight: Patchy for Richard Fahey last year and has reverted to type for his new yard this time, having kicked off with a C&D win off 2lb lower in May; does like it here though, and this a bit easier, having been said to have hung right at Chester last time.

RaceName: Follow Us On X @hamiltonparkrc Handicap
OwnerName: Peter Onslow, FDC Holdings Ltd & NWIR Ltd
Spotlight: Some promise on his York debut last spring but well below that level in two runs on Tapeta this summer (out of a Wolverhampton winner); interesting to see how he goes in the market now handicapping.

RaceName: Follow Us On X @hamiltonparkrc Handicap
Spotlight: Inconsistent mare who's been withdrawn on account of good to firm ground since disappointing on fast going early last month; holds claims on her previous Ffos Las second to a subsequent winner but only has a maiden win to her name.

RaceName: Follow Us On X @hamiltonparkrc Handicap
Spotlight: Plenty of defeats at short prices since her last victory, here almost two years ago; she's more than capable off this mark, though, if the first-time headgear does the trick in a winnable handicap.

RaceName: Follow Us On X @hamiltonparkrc Handicap
Spotlight: Usually makes the running but wasn't able to from stall 13 over 7f at Ayr on Saturday, an effort that confirmed him still in good form; only 1lb higher than when winning over C&D in May and is on the shortlist.

RaceName: Follow Us On X @hamiltonparkrc Handicap
Spotlight: Unlucky behind a subsequent winner last month and gave her running once more latest, both in small-field C&D affairs that weren't run to suit; the return to a bigger field should help and she has every chance, despite a 3lb higher mark.

RaceName: Follow Us On X @hamiltonparkrc Handicap
Spotlight: Left last year's debut behind when springing an 80-1 surprise over 9.2f here on her comeback in the spring; since disappointing in two handicaps and, while it's still early days, it's hard to be confident.

RaceName: Follow Us On X @hamiltonparkrc Handicap
Spotlight: Pulled too hard in two 1m2f handicaps earlier in the summer; hopefully the gelding operation and drop in trip will see him settle, in which case he ought to fare better for a yard with a decent record with 3yos here.

RaceName: Follow Us On X @hamiltonparkrc Handicap
OwnerName: Miss D Finkler, A Herd, Dr P Holloway 1
Spotlight: Has gone completely the wrong way, often from the front, mainly because of a tendency to pull hard; a lot will hinge on how things pan out early from stall 1 and how she settles in the first-time hood; risks involved either way.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap
Spotlight: Always tended to be hot and cold in the past, so disappointing he didn't fare better at Lingfield (AW) latest given a decent record there; not a lot of wiggle room off this mark and is now tried in first-time cheekpieces (wore blinkers twice as a 2yo).

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap
Spotlight: Ultra-consistent and arrives following a solid effort at Thirsk (same mark as tonight; his last winning rating); boasts a good record at this time of year and this is less competitive, so his claims are obvious.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap
Spotlight: Dual winner early last season who confirmed her liking for an easy 5f when going in again at Lingfield (AW) last October; off since an ordinary comeback in the spring and may need some help from the handicapper (4lb above her last successful mark).

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap
Spotlight: In good form at Windsor early in the summer but a couple of below-par efforts since, including back there; wants a proper test over an easy 5f and will need to bounce back to his best off this mark.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap
Spotlight: Made all when winning off this mark on his comeback over C&D in the spring; bounced back from a poor one at Newmarket (doesn't seem to like it there) when not beaten far last time and there's no obvious reason he won't go well again.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap
Spotlight: Decent comeback effort off a 3lb higher mark in June but has struggled twice since, losing his unbeaten Ripon record as favourite before finishing a remote last of four latest; something to prove now.

RaceName: Oddschecker+ Subscription Service Handicap
Spotlight: Prolific winner but never off a mark this high (Bath victory in early summer came off 5lb lower) and she's not still improving at her age; an easy 6f or stiffer 5f is optimal and she'll need to bounce back from a couple of lesser efforts.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Front-runner whose three turf wins have all been on ground slower than good, the most recent coming when holding on at Chester (6f, good to soft) two months ago; may not have things all his own way in front but commands respect off this 2lb higher mark.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Has won twice this year (both when ridden by P J McDonald), at Haydock (5f, soft) in May and Carlisle (5f, good to soft) in June; well beaten at York (6f, good to firm) last time, but that was a 0-105 and he wasn't best drawn; drops back down in grade and should have this run to suit.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Dual winner over 6f (good/good to soft), the most recent coming at Doncaster last summer off a 3lb lower mark; fifth in the Ayr Bronze Cup in September (soft) and he ran well when second of 17 there last month; has to be respected.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win from 18 starts came on his debut in a 5f maiden on soft ground in May 2024 but he has posted some good efforts since; midfield finishes in three starts this year, including when drawn wide at York over 7f on his last two outings; drops back in trip and down in grade with the visor returning.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Gained her fourth success when winning at 14-runner handicap at Ayr (6f, soft; Parisiac was second) in June but she was well beaten off this mark at Newmarket (good to firm) last month; needs to bounce back.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Tongue tied for the first time when showing a good attitude to win at Ripon (6f, good; flag start) in May when last seen; only 1lb higher and he can be competitive granted he's ready to go on his first outing for 95 days.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: All four wins have been on the AW; ran an encouraging race when fourth of eight on his stable debut at Newbury (6f, good to soft) in June but he wasn't able to build on that when dropped back to 5f at Newmarket (good to firm) last month; back up in trip.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Made all over C&D in June before good runner-up efforts behind Trilby and Novamay on his next two starts; however, he was below his best at Ayr last time and will likely face competition for the lead.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Won a C&D maiden in 2024; ran well here on his first two starts this year and won a handicap by a neck at Chester (5.5f, good) last month; form figures at this track read 14232 and he makes the shortlist.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time AW winner, the most recent coming at Southwell (6f) in February off a 7lb lower mark; shaped as if still in form when fifth of ten at Musselburgh (7f, good) in April but he's been off since; could go well with the likely strong gallop suiting him.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Course winner last June off a 10lb higher mark than today's, but he's been struggling in recent starts and hasn't won over 6f since August 2022; best watched at present.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark when winning on his stable debut at Chester (7.5f, soft) in June before finishing behind Iris Dancer here next time; below his best on the AW two weeks ago and cheekpieces are now reached for.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win on turf came at Ayr (5f, good to soft) last September; has ran to a similar level on her last four outings, most recently when third of nine at Ascot (5f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) 18 days ago; stepping back up in trip will suit and she's considered.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
Spotlight: Course specialist having won over this C&D 12 times, most recently last month off a 1lb lower mark than today's; below her best when dropped back to 5f here ten days ago but she's the type to bounce back on her return to this trip.

RaceName: Oddschecker Fillies' Handicap
OwnerName: Hold My Beer, Gee Gees Racing & N Clark
Spotlight: Often highly tried last year; generally consistent in handicaps this season, off a sliding mark, but finding the right trip seems to be an issue, with her going up from 1m to 1m2f last time, and now dropping to 6f; blinkers are given a second try.

RaceName: Oddschecker Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Doesn't appeal as the easiest, often pulling hard and hanging left, but she's progressed, latterly when making a successful handicap debut off 2lb lower at Epsom 12 days ago; perhaps tonight's flatter track will help and it's still early days with her.

RaceName: Oddschecker Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Kempton winner in the winter who's been expensive to follow otherwise, getting turned over at 3-1 or shorter five times; latest effort, her first in a sprint, was too bad to be true, but first-time headgear is now applied.

RaceName: Oddschecker Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Pulled hard and didn't see out 7f from the front last time, but she's now finished well held at big prices all three runs; needs a good forward step now handicapping.

RaceName: Oddschecker Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Won five times last season, including two over C&D, latterly off an 8lb higher mark; much her best effort of the year at Salisbury last time, off the same mark behind a subsequent winner, and is shortlisted back here for the first time in a while.

RaceName: Oddschecker Fillies' Handicap
Spotlight: Enjoyed a good summer at a lower level but a slow start did for her when odds-on in a small field a fortnight ago; clearly well suited by a stiff 6f and this will be a different test against a better class of opponent.

RaceName: Book Your Christmas Party At Hamilton Park Handicap
Spotlight: Has never run on ground faster than good and has a couple of heavy-ground wins to his name; 0-13 here but has gone close more than once and arrives in form, having responded well to a switch to front-running at Ayr last month; leading claims upped 2lb.

RaceName: Book Your Christmas Party At Hamilton Park Handicap
Spotlight: Irish raider who won a 0-50 classified event over the weekend; this looks a bit more competitive under a 4lb penalty but the longer trip will suit, with him taking a while to get on top over 1m2f at Ayr; goes on the shortlist.

RaceName: Book Your Christmas Party At Hamilton Park Handicap
Spotlight: Best efforts have come at around 1m2f and he hasn't looked to see it out in a handful of starts over further, latterly in first-time cheekpieces (switches to blinkers tonight) at Musselburgh 11 days ago; on a competitive mark now otherwise.

RaceName: Book Your Christmas Party At Hamilton Park Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs C Clark D Pollitt & Mrs E Quinlan
Spotlight: Not a bad comeback from a lengthy absence at Ayr yesterday (1m), having been off since pulled up a couple of times over hurdles; maybe enough of an ask to go again so soon and this would be as far as he's been on the Flat.

RaceName: Book Your Christmas Party At Hamilton Park Handicap
Spotlight: Achieved little last season but much better in two runs this time, getting off the mark in a messy Beverley affair seven weeks ago off 2lb lower (unlucky runner-up has done little for the effort since); this looks stronger but she may yet have more to offer.

RaceName: Book Your Christmas Party At Hamilton Park Handicap
Spotlight: Related to some useful winners, mainly over shorter, but isn't up to much himself (1m-1m3f); huge price for his handicap debut recently, back from a second round of wind surgery, and ran no sort of race at Ayr yesterday (1m).

RaceName: Book Your Christmas Party At Hamilton Park Handicap
Spotlight: Regressive maiden who again pulled hard when some way behind Patrick Street and Falaise Blanc at Ayr over the weekend; will need to settle much better coming back up from 1m2f.

RaceName: Book Your Christmas Party At Hamilton Park Handicap
Spotlight: Inconsistent gelding who went close over C&D in early June and came back to that sort of level when behind Patrick Street three days ago (8lb better off back into a handicap); often pulls hard and it will depend on his mood.

RaceName: Book Your Christmas Party At Hamilton Park Handicap
Spotlight: Started handicap life on an unrealistic mark but has found her level now, coming away with the favourite under a canny ride at Catterick a few weeks ago; that was the first time she'd made the running and she's considered upped a fair 2lb.
